rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever it fires, the shot's power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the robot's current energy must be strictly greater than the shot's power.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever it fires, there must be a scanned target whose scan is from this turn (age 0) and the gun must be pointing at that target within 3.0°; if it has no target or the scan is stale, it never fires.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

deleted_starters.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: Proved: both rules hold, but battles flagged an unproved rule S3
explanation.summary: Verus proved both rules it was asked to check: S1 (never fire a shot you can't afford) and S2 (only fire at a robot seen this turn, with the gun aimed at it). The battles, however, reported a violation of a rule called S3 starting on turn 2 (47 turns in the open arena, 76 in the city map). S3 is not among the rules or verdicts given to me, so I can't say what it requires or why it was broken.
